answer: Farming becomes a falcon bet on surviving 65 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the vertex schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 65 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 15 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
